lines.text: If you discover a fire, raise the alarm immediately, and follow the site emergency arrangements.
Only attempt to tackle a fire if you are trained, it is safe to do so, and you have a clear escape route.
Make yourself familiar with the emergency exits, the assembly point, and the location of fire-fighting equipment.
Hot works require the appropriate authorisation and controls.
In the event of a serious accident, contact the emergency services where necessary, and notify site management.
Do not move an injured person unless they are in immediate danger.
You must know who the first aiders are, and where the first aid equipment is located.
Raise the alarm. Know your way out. Know who can help.
